Market today: Tech is getting hammered, especially the leveraged names. The headlines are all over the place, but the real driver for your book is the broad tech sell-off, amplified by your margin.

Your holdings: SMCI (-24.93%), MUU (-35.44%), and SOXL (-62.82%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, these leveraged ETFs decay and margin amplifies drops. SPCX is a brand-new, very volatile IPO.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and any news impacting chip demand or AI.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your most exposed positions and protecting your capital.
plays: Trim SMCI: It's deep underwater and the trend is down. Consider cutting losses if it breaks below its stop.
Trim MUU: Similar to SMCI, this leveraged ETF is bleeding. Protect capital by trimming.
Trim SOXL: This 3x leveraged ETF is a major loser. Consider trimming to reduce risk.
